# Vendors reference

The vendor component, the vendor asset and its stock lines, and the live stock a shop window reads. For how to use it, see [Vendors](../modules/vendors.md).

## VtVendor

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Vendors → VtVendor**.

A shop on an NPC. Holds this instance's stock, prices items from their value and the vendor definition's multipliers, sells to and buys from a customer, and restocks on a timer. Opt in through `VtUnitDefinition.useVendor`; `VtUnit` attaches it.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vendor (`vendor`) | [VtVendorDefinition](#vtvendordefinition) | None |  | What this NPC sells and how it prices. Required. |
| Interact Radius (`interactRadius`) | `float` | 3 | ≥ 0 | Distance within which the player can trade. The walk-to-interact flow stops here. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyList<VtVendorStockState> Stock { get; }` | Live stock, one entry per line of the definition, in authored order. |
| `event Action<VtUnit> OnVendorOpened` | Fires when a player interacts with the vendor. Open your shop window here. |
| `event Action<VtUnit, VtItemDefinition, int, int> OnBought` | Fires after a purchase: (customer, item, count, total paid). |
| `event Action<VtUnit, VtItemDefinition, int, int> OnSold` | Fires after the vendor bought from a player: (customer, item, count, total received). |
| `event Action OnStockChanged` | Fires whenever a stock count or restock timer changed, including restocks and replication. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache the sibling unit and seed stock from the definition. Safe to call more than once; call it right after adding the component from code. |
| `int GetStock(VtItemDefinition item)` | Units of `item` left, -1 for unlimited, 0 when sold out or not carried. |
| `bool Sells(VtItemDefinition item)` | True when the vendor carries `item` at all. |
| `VtCurrencyDefinition GetCurrency(VtItemDefinition item)` | Currency a trade in `item` uses: the vendor's, else the item's. Null means no trade. |
| `int GetBuyPrice(VtItemDefinition item)` | Price per unit the customer pays, or 0 when the item is not carried. |
| `int GetSellPrice(VtItemDefinition item)` | Price per unit the vendor pays for `item`. |
| `bool IsWithinReach(VtUnit customer)` | True when `customer` stands within `interactRadius` plus the interact tolerance from the tuning asset. |
| `bool CanBuy(VtUnit customer, VtItemDefinition item, int count, out VtVendorFailureReason reason)` | Whether `customer` could buy `count` of `item` right now. Pure query; the first failing reason comes back. |
| `bool CanSell(VtUnit customer, VtItemDefinition item, int count, out VtVendorFailureReason reason)` | Whether the vendor would buy `count` of `item` from `customer` right now. Pure query. |
| `bool TryBuy(VtUnit customer, VtItemDefinition item, int count, out VtVendorFailureReason reason)` | Sell `count` of `item` to `customer`: charges the wallet, adds to the inventory, reduces stock. On a predicting client the request is forwarded and this returns false with `VtVendorFailureReason.AuthorityNotLocal`. |
| `bool TrySell(VtUnit customer, VtItemDefinition item, int count, out VtVendorFailureReason reason)` | Buy `count` of `item` from `customer`: removes from the inventory and credits the wallet. Forwards on a predicting client. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance restock timers. Runs on the authority only. |
| `void ApplyStockFromNet(IReadOnlyList<VtVendorStockState> snapshot)` | Replace the live stock with `snapshot`, matched by item. Used by loading and replication; not authority-gated. |
| `void CopyStockTo(List<VtVendorStockState> buffer)` | Copy the live stock into `buffer` for saving or sending. |

## VtVendorDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Vendors → Vendor Definition**.

Authored shop: what an NPC sells, how it prices, and whether it buys. Assign it to a unit definition with `VtUnitDefinition.useVendor` checked; `VtUnit` attaches a `VtVendor` that keeps the per-instance stock. Definitions are shared, so two merchants with the same asset have separate stock counts.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for save files and tooling. Convention: 'vendor.<town>.<name>'. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name shown on the shop window. |
| Currency (`currency`) | [VtCurrencyDefinition](currency.md#vtcurrencydefinition) | None |  | Currency this vendor trades in. Empty = each item's own value currency. |
| Buy Price Multiplier (`buyPriceMultiplier`) | `float` | 1 | ≥ 0 | What the player pays, as a multiple of the item's value. 1 = list price. |
| Sell Price Multiplier (`sellPriceMultiplier`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0 | What the vendor pays for the player's items, as a multiple of the item's value. 0.25 = a quarter. |
| Buys Items (`buysItems`) | `bool` | On |  | Whether the vendor buys items from the player at all. |
| Stock (`stock`) | [VtVendorStockEntry](#vtvendorstockentry)[] | Empty |  | What is for sale. One line per item. |

## VtVendorStockEntry

Serializable class.

One line of a vendor's stock: what it sells, at what price, how many, and how fast it restocks. Authored inline on a `VtVendorDefinition`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Item (`item`) | [VtItemDefinition](items.md#vtitemdefinition) | None |  | Item for sale. Required. |
| Price Override (`priceOverride`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Price per unit at this vendor. 0 = the item's value times the vendor's buy multiplier. |
| Stock (`stock`) | `int` | -1 | ≥ -1 | How many the vendor holds. -1 = unlimited. |
| Restock Seconds (`restockSeconds`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Seconds after the stock drops below full until it refills to Stock. 0 = never restocks. Counts in simulation time. |

## VtVendorStockState

Struct.

Live stock of one item at one vendor instance. Read through `VtVendor.Stock`; replicated and saved through `VtVendor.ApplyStockFromNet`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtItemDefinition Item` | The item this line sells. |
| `int Remaining` | Units left. -1 = unlimited. |
| `float RestockRemaining` | Seconds until the line refills, or 0 when full or never restocking. |

## Enums

### VtVendorFailureReason

Why a `VtVendor.CanBuy`, `VtVendor.CanSell`, `VtVendor.TryBuy` or `VtVendor.TrySell` call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The trade can go ahead. |
| `VendorNull` | The vendor component has no definition. |
| `ItemNull` | No item, or a count of zero. |
| `NotSold` | The vendor does not carry this item. |
| `OutOfStock` | The vendor holds fewer than asked. |
| `NoPrice` | The item has no value currency and no price override. |
| `NoWallet` | The customer has no wallet. |
| `CannotAfford` | The customer cannot pay. |
| `NoInventory` | The customer has no inventory. |
| `InventoryFull` | The purchase would not fit in the customer's inventory. |
| `NotSellable` | The item is not sellable, or the customer holds fewer than offered. |
| `VendorDoesNotBuy` | This vendor does not buy from players. |
| `TooFar` | The customer is farther from the vendor than its interact radius allows. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |
